observations: Top view of a car battery with a black plastic casing.
Label identifies the model as CMF80L.
Label and plastic casing both state 'MADE IN KOREA'.
A built-in hydrometer (magic eye) shows a green indicator.
One terminal is covered by a red protective cap.
Embossed codes 'ALS K80' and '803' are visible on the casing.
Barcode 8 809376 164475 is printed on the label.

claims.evidence: The brand name 'Everstart' is not visible on the label in photo 0.

risks.risk: The battery may be old stock or have internal degradation despite the green indicator.
risks.proof: A video showing a multimeter reading (voltage) and a load test result.

risks.risk: The battery may not be the 'Everstart' brand as claimed by the seller.
risks.proof: A photo of the complete top and side labels showing the brand logo.

risks.risk: The manufacture date is unclear; the code '803' could indicate an older production year.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the heat-stamped date code on the battery casing.

proof_requests: Photo of the full label showing the brand name.
Video of a multimeter reading showing the current voltage.
Close-up photo of any heat-stamped date codes on the top or side of the casing.
response.reason: The model CMF80L and the 80Ah capacity are clearly visible, which allows for pricing as a standard Korean-manufactured battery of this specification, even without the brand name confirmed.
